title.rendered: Arqaam Capital has received approval from ADX to provide SBL services for Abu Dhabi Securities

content.rendered:
We’re excited to share that Arqaam Capital Limited has received approval from ADX to provide Securities Lending and Borrowing (SBL) services for Abu Dhabi Securities. This milestone will enhance market liquidity and attract new investors across the UAE and GCC. With ADX’s market cap surpassing $750b USD, this is a pivotal step in boosting regional market efficiency. Stay tuned for more updates.

View More
